title: The Garden of Forking Paths: Threading Narrative Archetype as a Semantic Signal Through Gameplay Planning
abstract: arXiv:2605.01245v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative models can produce individual game facets, but whole-game generation remains an orchestration problem: narrative, level structure, encounters, objectives, rewards, and visuals must express shared intent. We present Forking Garden, a branching game generation system that uses narrative archetype as a persistent semantic signal across the generation pipeline. Narrative progression is represented as soft Rise/Fall states; candidate plot nodes are generated before structural constraints assemble archetype-conforming graphs. The same state then conditions encounter composition, objectives, rewards, and runtime difficulty adaptation, while a shared symbolic schema preserves narrative entities and gameplay configurations through content instantiation. Across 10 storylines, generated paths exhibit distinguishable archetypal trajectories, narrative threat predicts damage taken by a threat-blind combat agent, and generate-firs

translated_title: 小径分岔的花园：将叙事原型作为语义信号贯穿游戏玩法规划
translated_abstract: 生成式模型能够生成单个游戏要素，但整款游戏的生成仍然是一个编排问题：叙事、关卡结构、遭遇战、目标、奖励和视觉效果必须表达共同的意图。我们提出了Forking Garden，一个分支式游戏生成系统，它将叙事原型作为贯穿整个生成管线的持久语义信号。叙事进程被表示为软性的“上升/下降”状态；在结构约束组装出符合原型的图之前，先进行候选情节节点的生成。随后，同一状态用于调节遭遇战构成、目标、奖励和运行时难度自适应，同时共享的符号化模式在内容实例化过程中保留叙事实体与游戏玩法配置。在10条故事线的实验中，生成的路径展现出可区分的原型轨迹，叙事威胁能够预测一个对威胁不敏感的战斗代理所受到的伤害，并且生成优先……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Forking Garden分支式游戏生成系统，将叙事原型作为持久的语义信号贯穿叙事生成、关卡结构、遭遇战、目标和奖励的整个生成管线，并通过共享符号模式实现叙事与玩法配置的一致性，从而解决整款游戏生成中的编排问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Forking Garden, a branching game generation system that threads narrative archetype as a persistent semantic signal through the entire generation pipeline—conditioning narrative, level structure, encounters, objectives, rewards, and difficulty adaptation via a shared symbolic schema—to address the orchestration problem of whole-game generation.
